#!/bin/bash

# Load environment variables from the docker_config.env file
if [ -f /workspace/docker_config.env ]; then
    export $(cat /workspace/docker_config.env | xargs)
fi

# Docker cleanup script

# Set cleanup scope and filters based on environment variables
CLEANUP_SCOPE=${CLEANUP_SCOPE:-"all"}
FILTER=${FILTER:-""}

echo "Starting Docker cleanup with scope: $CLEANUP_SCOPE and filter: $FILTER"

# Example cleanup commands
if [ "$CLEANUP_SCOPE" == "all" ]; then
    docker system prune -af
else
    docker container prune -f
    docker image prune -af
fi

# Apply filters if any
if [ -n "$FILTER" ]; then
    echo "Applying filter: $FILTER"
    # Add filter logic here
}

echo "Docker cleanup completed."
